describe.chat: Look at up to {{MAX_VIEWS_PER_TURN}} Library photos you need to choose by what they show. A photo that already has a caption comes back as its caption, not as a picture. Pictures arrive in the next message; then call caption_asset for each so you never look at it again. Do not look at photos you can pick by name and shape.

again.description: Look at a captioned photo anyway, for example to correct its caption.
